description: This file implements a pipeline system for managing frame processors, including classes for pipeline source and sink, and the main pipeline class that connects processors in sequence, manages their lifecycle, and supports metrics collection.

classes.name: PipelineSource
classes.description: A frame processor that forwards frames upstream and downstream, acting as the source in the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineSink
classes.description: A frame processor that forwards frames upstream and downstream, acting as the sink in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Main class that connects a sequence of frame processors, manages their lifecycle, and supports metrics collection.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Routes frames based on direction, forwarding to upstream or downstream handlers.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the pipeline and all contained processors.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the pipeline and all contained processors.

methods.name: _link_processors
methods.description: Links all processors in sequence and sets their parent.

methods.name: processors_with_metrics
methods.description: Recursively collects all processors that can generate metrics.
